how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named jest suite run against it (`fnm exec --using 24 -- bun run test -- <suite>`), then the file restored from the string in memory before the next row. `before` is the shipped source verbatim, `after` the text that replaced it, so every row is replayable with a plain string replace; each anchor was asserted to occur exactly once before the run. No device was involved: the brief forbids one, so these eight rows are the whole proof for the comparison rule, the tag choice and the side interleaving, and they were run on 2026-11-15 in the worktree at `126c818c`. Every row left the file byte-for-byte as it found it and `git status` was clean after the last one, so the tree these rows ran against is the tree `node scripts/gate.mjs check` passed on (1953 tests / 86 suites, code tree `185a3bcc63a7`). Fix round 1 added the last 14 rows by the same method, each suite run as `fnm exec --using 24 -- npx jest scripts/__tests__/<suite>.test.js` on 2026-11-15 against the tree that became `99b202e9` and `9742de3f`; every file was restored before the next row, and that is the tree `node scripts/gate.mjs check` then passed on (1965 tests / 88 suites, code tree `e3533d4261b8`). The two rows for an explicit ref at HEAD and the row for an empty release side put the pre-fix expression back, so those tests are shown red against the old comparison and the old exit code, not against an arbitrary break.
